source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Fresh full nine-file calendar location patch read, including all browser fixtures, Storybook examples, Fluent and CSS hunks. #setLocation uses URL.parse(eventLocation.trim()) to choose link versus text; it does not restrict to http/https and displays/stores the original string. Click handling moves to the dialog but only prevents navigation with an explicit TODO in this landing. Historical updateDialogData calls the setter only for truthy locations, so this change does not establish clearing a previous location on empty input. Fixed source separately loads LOCATION with an empty-string fallback, clears it on reset, hides empty text/row and actually calls openLinkExternally. Current test verifies text, href, visibility, mocked external navigation and reset. The historical added assertions directly check applied text/href, as requested, but do not test link activation, clearing an existing location or protocol safety. No native URL opening, visual, keyboard or screen-reader validation ran. Review requests for CSS icon variables and a descriptive Location icon Fluent ID are applied in the owned hunks. The 40px design height is explicitly deferred to follow-up row gaps. Storybook template/import/style concerns remain scoped to readiness and ownership; existing stylesheet imports are not proof all import cleanup applied. Checked local logical groups and native-link styling separately from formatter output.
title: Calendar location value assertions and later navigation have distinct scope
